description:
Hi! I am a Computer Science and Engineering student interested in technology, space exploration, artificial intelligence, and problem-solving. I have basic knowledge of Python and am eager to learn new technologies and gain hands-on experience.

I am looking for teammates who are passionate, creative, collaborative, and willing to learn. Skills in Python, Machine Learning, Web Development, Data Analysis, UI/UX Design, and creative problem-solving would be a great addition to the team.
